items.description: Gravitron is a 2D precision platformer based on gravity, physics, and reflexes.Control the direction of gravity to guide Gravitron to the portal in each level. The character does not run, jump, or move like in a traditional platformer: it only falls. It is up to you to choose where it will fall, avoid hazards, and find the best path to the exit.Energy decreases constantly, so every second matters. Reaching the portal is the main goal, but finishing with more energy, dying less, and mastering each level are all part of the challenge.With short levels, high difficulty, and arcade scoring, Gravitron is made for players who enjoy trial and error, precise control, and that “one more try” feeling.Features:- Core gravity-shifting mechanic- 2D precision platforming- Short and challenging levels- Energy system that decreases over time- Performance-based scoring- Simple, direct, and demanding physics- Linear level progression- Arcade challenge for players who enjoy improving their execution Subscribe to our newsletter Get STEAM deals and FREE games in your inbox Game developers Want your game sold on DailyIndieGame?
